{{Quote|I need a new Master—one with the power to penetrate the defenses of Belia's stronghold and lay claim to her secrets.|Hetton|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[990 BBY]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] known as [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] undertook a '''mission''' to find the [[holocron of Belia Darzu]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Prior to the mission, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Bane had made several unsuccessful attempts at constructing a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] of his own. Due to efforts of his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], Bane confirmed that the secrets to creating such a device were located inside the [[Belia Darzu's fortress|fortress]] of the deceased [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Belia Darzu]]. To uncover these secrets, Bane traveled to the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress's]] location on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world of Tython, hoping to find the information inside Lord Darzu's own [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]].

After traveling to Tython and infiltrating Darzu's fortress, Bane eventually made his way into a large underground chamber. There, he located his target alongside the remnants of Darzu's [[technobeast]] [[Army/Legends|army]], the [[Metanecrons]]. These [[Mutant|mutated]] [[Cyborg/Legends|organic-metal]] hybirds swarmed against the Sith Lord as he attempted to seize the holocron of their deceased creator. Nonetheless, Bane single-handedly slaughtered the creatures and went on to claim his ultimate objective. Within the holocron of Belia Darzu, Bane gained new insight into a [[Rite of Commencement|ritual]] that would finally allow him to construct a holocron of his own.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Everything I know about Belia Darzu, including the hyperspace route to Tython, can be found on that datacard.|Hetton offers the location of Belia Darzu's fortress to Darth Zannah|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
In the aftermath of the [[New Sith Wars]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] by the name of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] sought to create his own [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], a device capable of harnessing the essence of its creator and storing their knowledge. After several unsuccessful attempts at constructing such a device, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Bane reached an impasse in his efforts, though he nonetheless refused to give up. At a later date, his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] known as [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], encountered an individual called [[Hetton]], a dedicated researcher of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] and lore. In their meeting, Hetton divulged information regarding [[Belia Darzu]], a deceased [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who stored her knowledge of creating holocrons inside a [[Belia Darzu's fortress|hidden fortress]]. In exchange for a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] containing the fortress's location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and a [[Tython hyperspace route (Hetton)|hyperspace route]] to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], Zannah agreed to join forces with Hetton against [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Bane. This was merely a ruse, however, resulting in Hetton's [[Death/Legends|death]] during his later [[Duel on Ambria (990 BBY)|encounter]] with Bane. With the information collected by his apprentice, Bane embarked on a new mission to find the fortress of Belia Darzu, and with it, the secrets to creating a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]].<ref name="DBROT" />

==Mission==
{{Quote|I feared the defenses of Belia's stronghold would be impenetrable.|Hetton|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
[[File:DarthBane-NEGTC.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Bane infiltrated the fortress of Belia Darzu.]]
In preparation for his mission, Darth Bane analyzed the datacard acquired by his apprentice, learning as much as he could about the Dark Lord Belia Darzu. Confident about the legitimacy of Hetton's research, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord confirmed that his new target, the [[holocron of Belia Darzu]], contained key information that would allow him to construct a holocron of his own. To reach the fortress where the device was being held, Bane used his personal [[Starfighter/Legends|startfighter]], the [[Mystic (starfighter)|''Mystic'']], to traverse into the [[Deep Core]], a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] where the planet Tython was located. Traveling alone, he successfully navigated the hazardous [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] of the Deep Core and arrived at Tython. Detecting no lifeforms within Lord Darzu's fortress, Bane converged on its location, only to have his [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] fired upon by a pair of [[Automated defense system|automated]] tower-mounted [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. Using his [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] skills, Bane evaded the barrage and destroyed the [[Turret/Legends|turrets]], allowing the Sith Lord to land a short distance away from the fortress. As he approached the fortress's entrance, Bane used the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to blast open the front gate, providing him access to the building's interior.<ref name="DBROT" />

Within the fortress, Bane explored the facility room by room for any sign of his target. In this time, he briefly looked upon the remaining parts of Darzu's [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] research, though eventually Bane refocused his attention towards locating the holocron of the deceased Dark Lord. During his excursion in the fortress, Bane felt the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] lingering throughout its halls, prompting him to seek out the source of this energy. This search led Bane into an underground section of the fortress, revealing a large chamber that served as an inner sanctum. Inside this chamber, Bane finally discovered a pedestal in the middle of the room holding his ultimate prize—Lord Darzu's holocron. Surrounding the device, however, were the remnants of the [[Metanecrons]],<ref name="DBROT" /><ref name="END" /> an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Mutant|mutated]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] known as [[technobeast]]s. When Bane drew closer to the pedestal, the technobeasts initially ignored him completely. Immediately as he attempted to seize the holocron, however, the creatures became enraged and attacked the Sith Lord in a swarm.<ref name="DBROT" />

With both the Force and his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Bane defended himself and destroyed several of the technobeasts, using his [[orbalisk armor]] for protection against their melee attacks. In his battle against the creatures, Bane was abruptly pummelled by one of the larger mutated [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] variants. The attack hurled the Sith Lord face-first into a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] technobeast that infected him with the [[nanogene spore]], a [[virus]] that transformed living beings into the metal-organic hybrids themselves. Once again, however, the [[orbalisk]]s on Bane's [[Armor/Legends|armor]] saved his life, purging the virus from his body and preventing it from [[Lobotomy|lobotomizing]] his [[Brain/Legends|brain]]. As the effects of the nanogene spore subsided, the Sith Lord launched a counterattack against the rancor, ultimately destroying it and continuing his fight against the remaining [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] mutants. Despite the relentless aggression of the technobeasts, Bane single-handedly destroyed all of the creatures in the chamber. After a massacre that lasted for over an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]], Bane took but several [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] to recover—both physically and mentally—before finally claiming the holocron of Belia Darzu.<ref name="DBROT" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The process of creating a Holocron cannot be rushed. The adjustments to the matrix must be made with precision and care.|The gatekeeper of Belia Darzu's holocron teaching Darth Bane|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
With the holocron in his possession, Darth Bane began to scour its contents, interacting with the device's [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] in the form of an avatar depicting Belia Darzu. While doing so, Bane came across a set of instructions detailing the entire process of building a holocron. Though he was already familiar with most of this information, one particular element of these instructions had eluded him up to this point: the trapping of the creator's essence into the [[capstone]] of the holocron. After Bane questioned the gatekeeper on this process, the holocron depicted a Sith [[Force power/Legends|ritual]] known as the [[Rite of Commencement]]. Despite the complexity of the ritual, of which Bane mused would likely take him months to memorize, the Sith Lord was nonetheless satisfied with the new insights he had gained.<ref name="DBROT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Tython first appeared in ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', the second volume of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']] by author [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="DBROT" />
